title: Moxley takes New Japan’s world title
summary: Jon Moxley challenges Naito for New Japan’s top championship and carries the belt into a crossover reign. Naito pursues a rematch to bring the title back to his own side.

chapters.title: Moxley becomes IWGP World champion
chapters.context: The challenger reaches New Japan’s summit, while Umino stops a subsequent Narita attack and the new reign gains immediate enemies.

chapters.title: Naito wins the title back
chapters.result: Naito defeats Moxley to regain the world championship.
chapters.context: The joint event provides the return match and a championship recovery for the former titleholder.
